source_coverage.aggregation: five-minute means of finite observed values; separate count for every KPI; no imputation or clipping
source_coverage.non_target_explanation: configuration, signal scheduling/power descriptors and existing rolling-history fields are context rather than the selected radio/service-quality targets; packet-loss/error fields require missing-value/unit semantics confirmation
limitations: No normal/attack labels: calibration limits empirical flagging, not certified false-positive rate.
A five-minute average can attenuate short spikes; this experiment detects sustained aggregate deviations.
Device strings may identify device models, not unique physical devices.
Serving-cell identities are retained for audit; models may pool multiple cells within a context.

interpretation: Retrospective calibrated exploration; calibration fraction is not independent performance or a guaranteed future false-positive rate.

input_imputation.rule: fit-reference mode for CQI/RI/pcmax; median for other KPIs; per-context
input_imputation.no_fit_observations: leave missing and unscored; do not borrow calibration/test values
input_imputation.qualification: Predictions on imputed values are model outputs for estimates, not measured KPI health.

reasons.mean_latency: 平均时延描述业务响应的典型时间水平。
reasons.max_latency: 最大时延保留时延突增和长尾响应信息。
reasons.mean_dev_latency: 保留来源时延偏差字段，补充均值和最大值的波动信息。
reasons.rsrp: 保留原来源参考信号接收功率字段，描述信号强度；按既有设备、场景和制式上下文分别建模。
reasons.sinr: 保留原来源信干噪比字段，描述信号与干扰噪声的相对关系。
reasons.ss_sinr: 保留NR同步信号信干噪比作为独立质量指标；结构不适用时保留N/A，不与其他制式字段合并。

excluded_reasons.rsrq: 业务任务保留信号强度与SINR作为辅助无线指标，不重复纳入全部无线质量字段。
excluded_reasons.rssi: 与已选参考信号强度及SINR的质量信息部分重叠，核心集合不重复纳入总接收功率。
excluded_reasons.cqi: 反馈或时间聚合等级是间接质量信息；本精简集合优先直接信号测量和业务性能，不按测试结果选择。
excluded_reasons.ss_rsrp: 时延任务保留业务时延及原来源RSRP、SINR与NR质量信息，不重复加入所有强度字段。
excluded_reasons.ss_rsrq: 与已选NR强度/信干噪信息部分重叠，且部分原参考上下文不适用，精简时保留更少的NR质量字段。
excluded_reasons.min_latency: 与已选平均、最大及偏差时延统计部分重复；核心异常检测优先典型水平、突增和波动。

selected_feature_policy.source_metadata_quality_fields: preserved source-level annotations; not selected-KPI missingness denominators

record_rule: No record-level predictions are reused here. Run summarize_by_label separately for within-method any-applicable-KPI OR with undetermined records retained.
label_interpretation: Dataset attack/benign labels are not per-KPI health truth; unknown and unlabelled records remain separate.
